title: Independence analysis — Parallel Agent Dispatcher
description:
The parallel agent dispatcher turns a bag of independent tasks into a coordinated fleet: it partitions work, assigns each partition to an agent, watches progress, collects results, and handles stragglers. Speedup is real but not free — the dispatcher's art is partitioning for even load, minimizing coordination overhead, and making partial failure survivable. It is how the archive does in minutes what one agent does in a day.

This record documents the independence analysis approach: Verify tasks are truly independent (no shared mutable state) before dispatching in parallel.

Teaching ladder rank 1 (foundations): this record explains the core idea in plain terms — what inputs the tool takes, what outputs it produces, and when it is the right choice for an archive task.
